name: radius-panel
description: Dashboard de administracion para FreeRADIUS (rlm_sql / MySQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
